budget_items.what_was_recorded: Total FY17 revenues came in above the revenue estimates by a percentage.
budget_items.quote: total revenues for fy17 were 1.07% more than what our revenue estimates were.

budget_items.topic: Local receipts and motor vehicle excise
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Local receipts were collected above estimate, with motor vehicle excise a major increase.
budget_items.quote: motor vehicle excise at $253,604 more than estimated

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Miscellaneous non-recurring revenues ran over budget, mostly from one-time water betterments.
budget_items.quote: miscellaneous non reoccurring revenues $156k more than what was budgeted.

budget_items.topic: Water betterments from Meadow Woods trailer park
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A one-time water betterment payment from Meadow Woods contributed to the miscellaneous revenue increase.
budget_items.quote: water betterment's from meadow woods trailer park. $62,781.

budget_items.topic: Tax collections and tax lien revenue
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Taxes collected were a percentage of the levy, below the levy estimate, offset by tax lien revenue not in the estimate.
budget_items.quote: we received $96k in tax lien revenue that was not accounted for in the estimate.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: State aid came in above estimate, mostly from charter school tuition.
budget_items.quote: state aid: received $50,285 more than estimated.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Expenditures were encumbered at a percentage of budget, with appropriation close-outs totaling a figure.
budget_items.quote: we expended and or encumbered 99.49% of budgeted expenditures.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Appropriation close-outs totaled a figure at year end.

budget_items.topic: Payments above State assessment (Choice and Charter tuition)

budget_items.quote: we also paid $170,787 more than our state

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Free cash was estimated for the current year.
budget_items.quote: free cash is estimated at $800k for this year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The snow deficit was covered; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the snow deficit was able to be covered.
